name: 180-descent
description: The 180-Day Descent: a book-like website, EPUB, and PDF project.

scripts.dev: tsx scripts/cli/prepare-assets.ts && npm run build:social-cards && astro dev
scripts.build:site: tsx scripts/cli/prepare-assets.ts && npm run build:social-cards && astro build
scripts.build: tsx scripts/cli/preflight.ts && npm run build:site && npm run build:epub && npm run build:pdf
scripts.check:built: npm run check:links && npm run check:content && npm run check:imports && npm run check:dead && npm run check:svg-text && npm run check:math && npm run check:appendix-style && npm run check:clean && npm run check:workflows && npm run check:seo && npm run check:a11y && npm run check:rendered-type && npm run check:epub && npm run check:pdf
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run check:built
scripts.deploy: npm run check && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=2d1c3c8a1cc008cbb7faa7ea85d69b87 wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name=180-descent
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run check && CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=2d1c3c8a1cc008cbb7faa7ea85d69b87 wrangler pages deploy _site --project-name=180-descent --branch=staging
